payload.prompt: /patch Issue #1: In `mas-settings.js`, the `valueEditorType` getter's override-dialog branch (lines 386-389) handles `quantity-select` and `addon` editor types but not `select`. When a user edits a locale override for `ctaMode`, `valueEditorType` returns `'text'` instead of `'select'`, causing a free-text `<sp-textfield>` to render rather than the `<sp-picker>` dropdown with the valid `default`/`buy-only`/`trial-only` options. Resolution: Add `if (this.settingDefinition?.editor === 'select') return 'select';` inside the `if (this.dialog?.type === 'override')` block (after line 388), following the same pattern as the existing `quantity-select` and `addon` checks. Severity: tech_debt
